runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on current official government, Natural England and Planning Data readbacks, with EIA/HRA/SEA stages and dataset coverage explicitly separated from parcel-level consent or feasibility conclusions.

sources.label: GOV.UK Environmental Impact Assessment
sources.fact: Town and country planning EIA in England is governed by the 2017 Regulations; Schedule 1/2 screening and Environmental Statement requirements are project-specific.

sources.label: GOV.UK Appropriate assessment
sources.fact: Plans/projects require HRA screening where habitats-site effects may arise; appropriate assessment is required when likely significant effects cannot be excluded.

sources.label: GOV.UK Habitats regulations assessments
sources.fact: Competent authorities must assess proposals that could significantly harm designated features before approval/adoption.

sources.label: Planning Inspectorate NSIP HRA advice
sources.fact: Updated 14 July 2026; distinguishes screening, appropriate assessment and derogation stages for NSIPs.

sources.label: Natural England/EA environmental planning advice
sources.fact: Natural England and Environment Agency consultation is required for relevant environmental assessments; extra information can be requested even where a formal assessment is not needed.

sources.label: Natural England protected species planning advice
sources.fact: Protected-species standing advice supports planning decisions and identifies cases requiring Natural England consultation.

sources.label: GOV.UK SEA and sustainability appraisal
sources.fact: SEA/SA are plan-making assessment tools and are distinct from project-level EIA and HRA.

sources.label: Planning Data SSSI
sources.fact: 4,128 SSSI records; collector 23 July 2026; origin caveat includes some MHCLG-created data being replaced by authoritative sources.

sources.label: Planning Data Special Area of Conservation
sources.fact: 260 SAC records; collector 26 July 2026; dataset origin caveat retained.

sources.label: Planning Data Special Protection Area
sources.fact: 88 SPA records; collector 24 July 2026; dataset origin caveat retained.

sources.label: Planning Data Ramsar
sources.fact: 73 Ramsar records; collector 24 July 2026; coverage/origin caveats retained.

sources.label: Planning Data Infrastructure project
sources.fact: 233 project boundaries; collector 24 July 2026; boundaries inform EIA consultation and may change, so they are not fixed parcel entitlements.

examples.result: EIA screening is not inferred from parcel size alone; Schedule/type/sensitivity and actual proposal evidence are required.
An Environmental Statement is evidence for assessment, not proof that permission will be granted.
HRA screening must consider in-combination effects; dataset proximity alone is not an appropriate assessment.
Where likely significant effects cannot be excluded, appropriate assessment remains a competent-authority task.
SEA/SA plan evidence is not substituted for project EIA or parcel-level environmental clearance.
SSSI/SAC/SPA/Ramsar dataset absence is not negative proof because source/coverage caveats remain.
Infrastructure-project EIA boundaries are explicitly changeable and are not treated as cadastral boundaries.
No environmental-assessment promotion occurs without exact geometry, current proposal and competent-authority evidence.
